A planetary scientist is analyzing the radiation absorption properties of four gases discovered in the atmosphere of a satellite. The table below displays the percentage of incoming short-wavelength radiation and outgoing long-wavelength radiation absorbed by each gas.

GasAbsorption of short-wavelength radiation (%)Absorption of long-wavelength radiation (%)
W9211
X586
Y46
Z9491

Which gas acts as a greenhouse gas by allowing most solar radiation to reach the surface while trapping thermal radiation within the atmosphere?

  1. Gas W
  2. Gas X
  3. Gas Y
  4. Gas Z
